findings.title: Exception is caught and ignored
findings.explanation: The handler body only contains `pass`/`continue`, so the error is discarded without logging or recovery.
findings.impact: Bugs and outages become invisible; data may be left half-written.
findings.remediation: Log the error with context, re-raise, or handle it explicitly.

findings.title: MD5/SHA-1 used
findings.evidence:
"""
    return hashlib.sha1(string)
findings.explanation: MD5/SHA-1 used. These are broken for security purposes. (CWE-327). Detected by Semgrep pattern matching; the code shown matched rule `py-weak-hash`.
findings.impact: If used for passwords, signatures or integrity checks, collisions/brute force are practical.
findings.remediation: Use hashlib.sha256 for integrity, and argon2/bcrypt/scrypt for passwords.
